title: The periodic table
group: CHEM-ATOM / CHEM-PER — Atoms & the Periodic Table
examples: How do we know which element goes next?
What is the difference between a group and a period?
Why are some elements called metals?

explain.say: The periodic table organizes all known elements in a pattern.
The vertical columns are called groups; elements in a group share similar properties.
The horizontal rows are called periods, and they tell us the number of electron shells.
Elements are generally sorted into metals, non-metals, and sometimes metalloids.
Dmitri Mendeleev arranged the table by atomic mass and properties.
Mendeleev left gaps for undiscovered elements, predicting their properties accurately.

faq.q: What is the difference between a group and a period?
faq.a: A group is a vertical column where elements share similar chemical properties. A period is a horizontal row that shows the number of electron shells an atom has.

faq.q: Why are some elements called metals?
faq.a: Metals are usually shiny, solid at room temperature, and are good conductors of heat and electricity. They tend to lose electrons.

faq.q: What did Mendeleev do with the gaps?
faq.a: Mendeleev left gaps because he knew elements existed that had not yet been discovered. He predicted what those missing elements would be like.
asks: Did Mendeleev guess the missing elements?
Why did he leave empty spots?

faq.q: Do all elements in a group behave the same way?
faq.a: They tend to behave similarly because they have the same number of valence electrons. This gives them similar chemical reactions.
asks: Is chemical behavior the same in a group?

faq.q: Is the periodic table always correct?
faq.a: The table is very accurate, but scientists continue to discover and refine our understanding of elements. It is a model of knowledge.

facts: Groups are vertical columns, and periods are horizontal rows.
Metals are generally shiny and good conductors of electricity.
Mendeleev arranged the table based on known properties.
The table includes elements like oxygen and iron.

quiz.say: Elements in the same vertical column are called:
quiz.why: Groups are the vertical columns that group elements with similar properties.

wrong.0: Rows is a general term, but 'periods' is the specific term for horizontal rows.
wrong.1: While sometimes used, 'groups' is the standard scientific term.
wrong.3: Periods are the horizontal rows, not the vertical columns.

quiz.say: Which characteristic is typical of most metals?
quiz.why: Metals are known for being shiny and able to conduct heat and electricity well.

wrong.0: This describes non-metals, which are the opposite of metals.
wrong.1: Metals can be solid, liquid, or gas, but are rarely only gaseous.
wrong.2: While reactive, many metals are also stable and conductive.

quiz.say: When Mendeleev left gaps in the table, he was:
quiz.why: He used existing patterns to predict the properties of elements not yet found.

wrong.0: His predictions were based on scientific patterns, not random guessing.
wrong.2: He was not making mistakes; he was making educated scientific predictions.
wrong.3: He used known data to make the predictions, not ignore it.
